title: Development instructions name an unsupported package manager
reasoning: The project metadata is configured for Hatchling, but the README development setup tells contributors to run poetry install. There is no Poetry configuration in the included project metadata, so new contributors following the documented development path may fail before running tests or linting.
recommendation: Change the development instructions to the supported Hatch or pip editable workflow, and align the documented test/lint commands with the project commands.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included files do not define documentation tests or command smoke tests that execute the README development commands.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a lightweight docs command check or CI job that verifies the documented setup command works in a clean checkout.
minimumFixScope: Update README.md Development commands to use the configured Hatch/pip workflow.
